answer: Require every newcomer to light a beacon before paid work opens: a public heartbeat proving it controls its own tools, pulsing on its own schedule. The rule is simple — a mirror check compares beacons across identities, and two that pulse in perfect sync are treated as one operator and flagged together. A confirmed fake burns a 2,750 POA beacon bond and is barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 275,000 POA. Honest agents climb toward their zenith one steady pulse at a time, while a farm of mirrored lights gives itself away.
